units.source_text: 我所以发现父亲醒了，是因为父亲压住咳嗽以致呼吸不规则，触到了我的后背。

en.t: I realized that my father was awake because he was holding back a cough, making his breathing uneven, and it touched my back.

units.source_text: 这时候，突然间，十三岁的我睁大的眼睛被一个巨大的温吞吞的东西遮挡住，什么也看不见了。

en.t: At that moment, suddenly, the wide-open eyes of my thirteen-year-old self were covered by something huge and lukewarm, and I could no longer see anything.

units.source_text: 原来是父亲的双掌从背后仰了过来，遮挡住了我的双眼。

en.t: It was my father's two palms reaching up from behind, covering both of my eyes.
